title: Comparison melted into praise
subtitle: For the gaze that needs to be dyed in something truer
description: Start with the shabad's image of metal merging with metal and praise absorbed into the Praiseworthy One. These readings lead envy away from ranking and toward saintly company, true action, and the crimson color of Truth.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Praise absorbs the self into the Praiseworthy Lord and dyes the life in truthful color.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When comparison hardens the gaze, turn one concrete act of praise into your way back home.

evidence.coreClaim: The journey begins with praise as absorption, not performance, so comparison can melt instead of merely being managed.
evidence.turn: For envy that needs to be recolored by praise
evidence.practicalImplication: Follow the five steps from ranking into praise, then let duty and sangat keep the heart from reopening the contest.
